content.comment_body: Where can I find a new firmware update for [product_name] [version_no]? Looking to update my device. [article_no]

Updating the firmware on [product_name] isn't supported. When you purchase a new unit, it might come with the latest firmware, but [company_name] does not announce when new firmware versions are released. What is the reason you need an update?
[version_no] is the most recent firmware for [product_name]. Updating from an older to a newer version is not possible, and there are no newer versions beyond [version_no] at this time.
A new question from [user_name] was moved to its own thread regarding [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] always showing 'wrong password'. Best regards [user_name]

That's not entirely accurate. Only [product_name] devices from firmware versions V1.81.01 or V1.81.02 can be updated to FS06 (V1.81.03). Not every [product_name] with an SD card slot can receive updates. Units [article_no] with firmware from V1.08.01 to V1.08.03 cannot be updated.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for firmware updates for [product_name] hardware, specifically for modules like [article_no]. Feedback indicates updates are rarely possible except for some specific combinations of hardware and firmware. There is confusion about which devices can be updated and a lack of clear official communication from [company_name] regarding firmware releases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to locate and install firmware updates for their [product_name] modules, hoping this can improve device functionality or fix existing problems.
